description: Implementation of a GLX Pbuffer surface for EGL in the ANGLE project, managing creation, resizing, and lifecycle of Pbuffers on the Raspberry Pi 4 platform.

classes.name: rx::PbufferSurfaceGLX
classes.description: Class managing a GLX Pbuffer surface for EGL, including creation, resizing, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Pbuffer surface, creating a native GLX Pbuffer with specified dimensions.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the Pbuffer surface current (stub implementation).

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the buffer (stub implementation).

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the surface (unimplemented).

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases a texture image from the surface (unimplemented).

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the Pbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the Pbuffer.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Checks if post sub-buffer is supported (unimplemented).

methods.name: checkForResize
methods.description: Checks if resize is needed; always returns success as size doesn't change.

methods.name: getDrawable
methods.description: Returns the drawable handle for the Pbuffer.
